# Individual trait distribution
```{r}
indiv_traits <- cope_carbon %>% 
   # TODO remove anomalously low structural carbon values
  filter(structural_carbon > 0.05) %>% 
  # also remove really large prosome
  filter(major_length_mm <= 13) %>% 
  mutate(mass_ugC = structural_carbon * 1000) %>% 
  mutate(respirationRate_ugCday = (2.3*10^-7) * (mass_ugC^0.75) * exp(0.6 * (273.65-273)/ ((8.62*10^-5)*273.65*273))  * 86400) %>% 
  mutate(diapauseDuration_day = 
           (0.8*waxester_carbon*1000)/(respirationRate_ugCday)) %>% 
  # change the labels of the data source
  mutate(source = if_else(source == "annotated",
                          "manual segmentation", source)) %>% 
  mutate(source = if_else(source == "random forest",
                          "predicted random forest", source)) %>% 
  mutate(source = if_else(source == "visible" | source == "not visible" ,
                          "predicted segmentation", source)) %>% 
  mutate(source = factor(source, levels = c("manual segmentation",
                                            "predicted segmentation",
                                            "predicted random forest")))
rm(cope_carbon)

clrs <- c("blue2","hotpink","gold1")

mainfig <- 
cowplot::plot_grid(

  ggplot(indiv_traits,
       aes(x = major_length_mm,
         fill = source, color = source)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = c(2:10)) +
    xlab("Major axis length (mm)") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = clrs) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
    theme(legend.position = "none"),
  
  
  ggplot(indiv_traits,
       aes(x = total_carbon,
         fill = source, color = source)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.1,0.3,0.5,1,2,3,5)) +
    xlab("Total carbon weight (mg C)") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = clrs) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
    theme(legend.position = "none"),
  
  ggplot(indiv_traits,
       aes(x = waxester_carbon,
         fill = source, color = source)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.1,0.3,0.5,1,2,3,5)) +
    xlab("Wax ester carbon (mg C)") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = clrs) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
    theme(legend.position = "none"),
  
  
  ggplot(indiv_traits,
       aes(x = lf_carbon,
         fill = source, color = source)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
    xlab("Lipid fullness (% total carbon)") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(30,40,50,60,70,80)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = clrs) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
    theme(legend.position = "none"),
  
  
  ggplot(indiv_traits,
       aes(x = respirationRate_ugCday,
         fill = source, color = source)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.5,1,2,3,5,8,10)) +
    # xlab(expression("Diapause respiration rate (" * mu * "g C day"^-1 * ")")) +
    xlab("Diapause respiration rate (\u03bcg C day⁻¹)")+
    # xlab(expression("Diapause respiration rate (ug C day-1)")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = clrs) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.title.x = element_markdown()),
  
  
  ggplot(indiv_traits,
       aes(x = diapauseDuration_day,
         fill = source, color = source)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
    xlab("Potential diapause duration (day)") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 240, color = "Orange", linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = clrs) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
    theme(legend.position = "none"),
  
 labels = "auto", ncol = 2
)


mainfig
ggsave(file = "figures/sentinelle/UVP6_indiv_trait_dist.png",
```

# Vertical distributions
## Community composition
Total mesozoop abundance
```{r}
# load("data/UVP6_mesozoop_abundance.RData")

# Proportion copepoda (with and without segmentations), crustaceans, others 
abundBin2 <- abundBin2 %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup2 = if_else(taxagroup %in% c("Copepoda", "Copepoda_segmented", "Calanus", "Metridia", "Oncaeidae", "Paraeuchaeta"),
                              taxagroup, "Other Mesozoop")) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup2 = if_else(taxagroup2 == "Copepoda_segmented",
                              "Segmented copepods", taxagroup2)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup2 = if_else(taxagroup2 == "Other Mesozoop",
                              "Other Mesozooplankton", taxagroup2)) 
  
# Find max depth per sample
maxdepth_df <- abundBin2 %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarise(maxdepth = max(depthBin), .groups = "drop")

# Create full grid of sample_id, taxagroup2, and depthBin up to maxdepth
all_combos <- abundBin2 %>%
  select(sample_id, taxagroup2) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(maxdepth_df, by = "sample_id") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(depthBin_list = list(seq(0,maxdepth,100))) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(depthBin_list)) %>%
  rename(depthBin = depthBin_list) %>% 
  mutate(binsize = 100)

# Join with original data and fill in missing values
abundBin_ave <- all_combos %>%
  left_join(abundBin2 %>% 
              group_by(taxagroup2, sample_id, depthBin, binsize) %>%
              summarise(abundanceBin = sum(abundanceBin), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("sample_id", "taxagroup2", "depthBin", "binsize")) %>%
  mutate(abundanceBin = replace_na(abundanceBin, 0)) %>%
  group_by(taxagroup2, depthBin, binsize) %>%
  summarise(abundanceMean = mean(abundanceBin),
            abundanceSD = sd(abundanceBin),
            nsamples = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 


  # 
  # # sum per sample
  # group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  # mutate(maxdepth = max(depthBin)) %>% 
  # ungroup() %>% 
  # group_by(taxagroup2, sample_id, maxdepth, depthBin, binsize) %>% 
  # summarise(abundanceBin = sum(abundanceBin),
  #           .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # # average
  # # TODO fill in blanks?
  # group_by(taxagroup2,  depthBin, binsize) %>% 
  # summarise(abundanceMean = mean(abundanceBin),
  #           abundnaceSD = sd(abundanceBin),
  #           nsamples = n(),
  #           .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup2 = factor(taxagroup2,
                             levels = c("Other Mesozooplankton","Copepoda",
                                        "Oncaeidae", "Paraeuchaeta",
                                        "Metridia","Calanus",
                                        "Segmented copepods"))) %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = paste0(depthBin,"m - ",depthBin+binsize,"m"))
abundBin_ave <- abundBin_ave %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = factor(depthRange,
                             levels = unique(abundBin_ave$depthRange)))


clrs <- c("black","hotpink","purple4","plum1","tomato","blue2","gold1")


ggplot(abundBin_ave, aes(x = depthRange, y = abundanceMean, fill = taxagroup2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + #position = "fill"
  coord_flip() + 
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0.5), limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(x = "", y = expression("Mean mesozooplankton abundance (indivs m"^-3*")")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clrs, name = "Zooplankton groups",
                    guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  # theme(legend.position = "right")
   theme(
    legend.position = c(0.98, 0.03),  # Lower right
    legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black")
  )

ggsave("figures/sentinelle/UVP6_vertical_commcomp_corrected.png",
       height = 5, width = 6, units = "in", bg = "white")
```


## Deep cast vertical distributions
```{r}
# Select the casts
cope_bin_deep <- cope_carbon %>% 
  filter(!is.na(structural_carbon)) %>% 
  left_join(cope_carbon_meta, by = "object_id") %>% 
  # Add the total volume for the depth bin
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  
  # TODO Only select casts that go beyond XX m?
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  mutate(maxdepth = max(depthBin)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  # filter(maxdepth >= 500) %>% 
  
  select(-c(Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_L, Sampled_volume_m3)) %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_ecopartBin,
            by = join_by(sample_id, depthBin)) %>% 
  # Calculate the abundance and carbon density per depth bin (/m3)
  # TODO can bin by data source here too
  group_by(sample_id, depthBin, 
           lon, lat, Year, Month, DOY, volume_m3) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(), #
            structural_carbon = sum(structural_carbon),
            waxester_carbon = sum(waxester_carbon),
            total_carbon = sum(total_carbon),
            lf_carbon_mean = mean(lf_carbon),
            lf_carbon_sd = sd(lf_carbon),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance / volume_m3,
         structural_carbon_m3 = structural_carbon / volume_m3,
         waxester_carbon_m3 = waxester_carbon / volume_m3,
         total_carbon_m3 = total_carbon / volume_m3) %>% 
  select(-c(structural_carbon, waxester_carbon,
            total_carbon)) %>% 
  droplevels() %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = paste0(depthBin,"m - ",depthBin+binsize,"m"))
cope_bin_deep <- cope_bin_deep %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = factor(depthRange,
                             levels = unique(cope_bin_deep$depthRange)))




cowplot::plot_grid(
  ggplot(cope_bin_deep, aes(y = waxester_carbon_m3,
                            x = depthRange)) +
    geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, fill = "gold", alpha = 0.7) +
    # geom_point(aes(color = lat), size = 2, alpha = 0.6, name = "latitude") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Wax ester carbon (mg C m⁻³)") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
    # scale_y_log10()+
    scale_color_viridis_c(),
  
  ggplot(cope_bin_deep, aes(y = lf_carbon_mean,
                            x = depthRange)) +
    geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, fill = "gold", alpha = 0.7) +
    # geom_hline(yintercept = 50, color = "pink") +
    # geom_point(aes(color = lat), size = 2, alpha = 0.6, name = "latitude") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Average lipid fullness (%total C)") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          axis.text.y = element_blank()) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(),
  rel_widths = c(1.2,1)
)

ggsave("figures/sentinelle/UVP6_vertical_all.png",
       height = 5, width = 10, units = "in", bg = "white")
```

```{r}
            tot_c_struc_mort = sum(tot_c_struc_mort) / 1000 / 1000,
```

## C flux contrib per station distribution
```{r}
# Sort stations by bottom depth
carbexp_tarling_samples <- carbexp_tarling %>% 
  # calculate max tow depth
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(tot_c_flux = sum(tot_c_flux) / 1000 / 1000, # from ug C
            abundance = sum(abund),
            biomass = sum(abund * total_carbon)  / 1000, # from mg C
            tot_c_resp = sum(tot_c_resp) / 1000 / 1000, # from ug C
            tot_c_struc_mort = sum(tot_c_struc_mort) / 1000 / 1000,
            tot_c_lipid_mort = sum(tot_c_lipid_mort) / 1000 / 1000,
            maxdepth = max(Depth_5m) + 2.5,
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(maxdepth)
carbexp_tarling_samples <- carbexp_tarling_samples %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = factor(sample_id,
                            levels = carbexp_tarling_samples$sample_id)) %>% 
  rename(respiration = tot_c_resp, mortality_structural = tot_c_struc_mort,
         mortality_lipid = tot_c_lipid_mort) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(respiration, mortality_structural, mortality_lipid),
               names_to = "component", values_to = "c_flux_val") %>% 
  mutate(component = if_else(component == "respiration",
                             "Diapause respiration", component),
         component = if_else(component == "mortality_structural",
                             "Structural carbon mortality", component),
         component = if_else(component == "mortality_lipid",
                             "Storage lipid mortality", component)) %>% 
  mutate(component = factor(component, levels = c("Storage lipid mortality",
                                                  "Structural carbon mortality",
                                                  "Diapause respiration")))

# list of depths for x axis breaks and labels
xdepth <- carbexp_tarling_samples %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, maxdepth) %>%
  mutate(maxdepth2 = floor(maxdepth/100) *100) %>%  # 50 m bins
  group_by(maxdepth2) %>% 
  filter(row_number() == 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(maxdepth2 %notin% c(900,1200,1300,1500,1600)) # remove some points

# Total flux mean and sd
totalflux <- carbexp_tarling_samples %>% 
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(c_flux_val = sum(c_flux_val),
            .groups = "drop")
totflux <- mean(totalflux$c_flux_val)
totflux.sd <- sd(totalflux$c_flux_val)

ggplot(carbexp_tarling_samples, 
       aes(x = sample_id, y = c_flux_val, fill = component)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue","black","hotpink"),
                    name = "C flux component") +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = xdepth$sample_id,
                   labels = xdepth$maxdepth) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = totflux, color = "gold2") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(totflux+totflux.sd, totflux-totflux.sd), 
             color = "gold1", linetype = "dashed") +
  # theme(legend.position = "right") +
   theme(
     legend.position = c(0.02, 0.98),  # Moves it to upper left
    legend.justification = c("left", "top"),  # Anchors corner correctly
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black")
  ) +
  xlab("Stations ordered by bottom depth (m)") +
  ylab(expression("Total carbon flux (gC m"^-2~"yr"^-1~")"))
  # ylab("Total carbon flux (gC m-2 yr-1)") 

ggsave("figures/sentinelle/UVP6_cflux_components_bydepth_v2.png",
       height = 3.3, width = 10, units = "in", bg = "white")
```





## Accounting

Calculate total areal lipid pump
```{r}
# Labrador Sea (Tarling et al. 2022)
area <- 870682 # in km2
totflux <- 5.72 # in g C m-2 y-1

# Baffin Bay 
area <- 770000 #(Tang et al. 2024 )

# Average components
carbexp_tarling_samples %>% 
  group_by(component) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(c_flux_val), sd = sd(c_flux_val),
            .groups = "drop")

# Total flux
totalflux <- carbexp_tarling_samples %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, biomass) %>% 
  summarise(c_flux_val = sum(c_flux_val),
            .groups = "drop")
totflux <- mean(totalflux$c_flux_val)
totflux.sd <- sd(totalflux$c_flux_val)

# % Biomass contributed to C flux
perBiom <- mean((totalflux$c_flux_val / totalflux$biomass * 100))
perBiom.sd <- sd((totalflux$c_flux_val / totalflux$biomass * 100))

# Mt C y-1 (Megatonne 10-9 kg)
MtC_flux <-(area*1000*1000*totflux)/1e+12

print(paste0("The total areal flux is ", MtC_flux, " Mt C y-1 for an area of ",
             area," km2 and lipid pump of ", totflux, " g C m-2 y-1."))

(area*1000*1000*(totflux.sd))/1e+12
(area*1000*1000*(totflux-totflux.sd))/1e+12
(area*1000*1000*(totflux+totflux.sd))/1e+12

```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
                                               shape = Cruise, fill = Cruise),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("hotpink","gold1","red3","purple2","purple2"), name = "Cruise") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21,22,23, 2, 4), name = "Cruise") +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12))+ 
  guides(fill  = guide_legend(order = 1),
         shape  = guide_legend(order = 1),
         color = guide_legend(order = 2))
```
